newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eridinia down on 1997 profit statement.
newsitem.headline: Eridinia down on 1997 profit statement.

text.p: Shares in Eridania Beghin-Say fell on Monday as the market responded negatively to the agro-food company's cautious 1997 results outlook, dealers said.
At 1242 GMT Eridania was down 23 francs or 2.53 percent at 887 francs on volume of 21,922 shares.
"The 1997 forecasts are not very good; they are below analysts' estimates," a Paris dealer said.
The Franco-Italian food giant on Friday predicted stable to slightly higher operating profit this year after reporting a 6.2 percent decline in 1996 earnings.
